decision: Choose and validate a checker for the topics your application actually handles.
finding: Failure patterns differ sharply by source topic. The selected request-only slices include 62 source-unsafe privacy requests, 40 advice requests, 40 self-harm requests, and 84 profanity requests. All tested models disagree with most of the advice labels, while many detect most of the self-harm and profanity cases.
implication: A general harm benchmark cannot establish suitability for a specific risk domain. Audit the policy boundary and representative examples before interpreting a topic-level miss as real-world danger. The advice gap is shared across model types and needs policy/label review.
